sources.title: Aluminum Association 2021 Can LCA, section 3.2.3
sources.quote: The cans then undergo a quality control process to check the integrity of the final product before they are shipped to fillers.
sources.scope: Quality control followed by palletized shipment; does not specify this floor plan or staffing.

sources.title: Aluminum Association 2021 Can LCA, section 3.2.3
sources.quote: The cans are stacked onto plastic pallets for shipping. Layers of cans are separated using corrugated paper or plastic sheets.
sources.scope: Empty-can palletization; manual/robot task allocation below is authored, not observed.

sources.title: FILTEC Empty Can Inspection
sources.quote: The FILTEC Empty Can Inspection (ECI) Solution is a highly configurable system that uses Vision technology to detect defects in empty cans on lines running up to 2,400 cans per minute (CPM).
sources.scope: Vendor capability before filling; proposed adaptation to manufacturing end-of-line, not a verified integrated cell or throughput.

limitations: Representative baseline, not a surveyed factory
Autonomous means no routine in-cell intervention during normal operation, not zero humans over the lifecycle
All geometry is conceptual and all equipment footprints are assumed
No dynamic robot collision, cycle-time, structural, safety or throughput qualification
No SpaceIR provider used: OpenForma MechanicalIR and ProcessIR own these authored artifacts
109 MJ per 1000 cans belongs to whole can manufacturing and is NOT assigned to this cell
